dedicatedQuerySensitivityPolicy.definition: A measure is found only when its own targeted query returns the canonical city/row; a row co-displayed under another measure query is not counted.
dedicatedQuerySensitivityPolicy.note: Helsinki repeat 1 followed the broad 018 same-call policy and accepted beer from a canonical snippet returned in another query batch; repeats 2 and 3 enforced dedicated-query provenance. This policy sensitivity is retained rather than averaged away.

Helsinki.beer: observed once under broad policy; not observed under dedicated-query policy

Nha Trang.basis: USD displayCurrency page; native VND snippets explicitly rejected to avoid mixing

Beijing.basis: CNY mapped from ¥ plus explicit Beijing, China context; no conversion

rejectionReasonsForFinalAcceptance: Kyoto and Don Det were 0/5 in all three repeats; the frozen search route has a stable sparse/no-result failure.
Helsinki coverage changed from 5/5 broad same-call evidence to 3/5 and 4/5 under dedicated-query provenance; the 5th measure is not repeatably query-addressable.
Only Nha Trang and Beijing had 5/5 in all three runs, and both carry currency-basis review requirements.
